content.text: One continuous four-second historical live-action close shot from the supplied first frame. Only the same right writing hand, grey linen cuff, left fingertips, bamboo brush, blank paper edge and rough wooden desk in soft warm night lamp light. The brush tip stays visibly in physical contact with the paper as the wrist makes a few small natural writing strokes, pauses briefly, then lifts the brush at the end. The back of the hand occludes the written area behind it; the near blank paper margin, bristles, contact and a few short irregular ink traces are visible. No legible characters, words, symbols or numbers. Preserve the hand anatomy, wrist, brush and paper without morphing. Fixed low oblique view, no face, body or new person, no cut or transition. No subtitles, cards, tables, captions, text overlays, dark boxes, local blur patches or mosaic. There is no permitted speech: no dialogue, narration, extra human voice or metadata reading. No BGM or music. Only quiet synchronized brush-on-paper and cloth movement, soft room tone.
